guide.summary: Royal palace, Paseo del Prado museums, smaller house museums, parks and markets, with breakfast cafés, classic Madrid dining and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
highlights: Museo Nacional Centro de Arte Reina Sofía
guide.tip: Check closing days before you plan museum time: the Reina Sofía is closed on Tuesdays, while the Lázaro Galdiano, Sorolla and Romanticismo museums are closed on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Museo Lázaro Galdiano, Museo Sorolla, Museo del Romanticismo and Casa Alberto are closed on Mondays, and the Reina Sofía is closed on Tuesdays. Casa Lucio closes for all of August.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: The Palacio Real sells tickets by date and time slot, with a €0.77 online booking fee per ticket and entry ending an hour before closing. DiverXO releases each date 90 days ahead at midnight and takes a €450 per person deposit.

toolkit.label: Walk-in and queues
toolkit.copy: Salmon Guru says it works without reservations and seats you as soon as possible. The Círculo de Bellas Artes rooftop sells tickets only at reception from 14:00 to 16:00 and after 21:00, and a ticket does not guarantee a seat in its café area.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: The Palacio Real recommends not bringing backpacks, suitcases or large bags during its improvement works. Corral de la Morería does not admit children under 7, Museo Chicote bookings are for over-18s only, and DiverXO is not recommended for children under 10.

guide.dek: Group the Paseo del Prado museums around their free slots and closing days, and book DiverXO, the Palacio Real and the flamenco show ahead while leaving the cocktail bars for walk-ins.
intro: Start at the Palacio Real de Madrid on Calle de Bailén. From October to March, Patrimonio Nacional opens it from 10:00 to 18:00 Monday to Saturday and 10:00 to 16:00 on Sunday, and entry ends one hour before closing. You buy tickets for a date and time slot, and a self-guided visit costs €18 at the basic rate. During its improvement works, the palace recommends you leave backpacks, suitcases and large bags behind. It can also close for official events, and it closes all day on 25 December and from 15:00 on 24 and 31 December.

On the Paseo del Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza at number 8 offers free entry to its collection on Mondays from 12:00 to 16:00. On Saturdays it stays open until 23:00, with free entry from 21:00 to the temporary exhibitions on the ground floor and level -1. Guided visits to El universo freudiano de Dalí are listed into January 2027. The Reina Sofía, at Calle Santa Isabel 52, is closed on Tuesdays and charges €12 for general admission. You still need a ticket for its free hours. Its Palacio de Cristal in El Retiro is closed for building improvements and is wrapped in Andrea Canepa's Fardo until 1 January 2027.

For a quieter day, the Museo Lázaro Galdiano at Calle Serrano 122 is closed on Mondays and costs €8, and you can get in free Tuesday to Friday from 14:00 to 15:00. The Museo Sorolla is free, but while the Casa Museo is closed for rehabilitation, visits are limited to the new extension building at Calle Zurbano 68. El Retiro opens at 6:00 and closes at 22:00 from October to March, and you can rent rowboats on the Estanque Grande. The Real Jardín Botánico closes at 17:30 from November.

For food, DiverXO at Calle Padre Damián 23 serves only a tasting menu and opens Tuesday to Friday. Casa Lucio on Cava Baja serves lunch and dinner every day but closes for all of August. Taberna La Bola on Calle Bola marks 156 years with a 45€ anniversary menu. For drinks, Salmon Guru on Calle Echegaray takes no reservations and opens daily from 16:00. Museo Chicote on Gran Vía takes bookings only for over-18s. Chocolatería San Ginés says it is open every day of the year.
summaryCards: Book a timed slot at the Palacio Real, then walk to the Thyssen-Bornemisza or the Reina Sofía, remembering that the Reina Sofía is closed on Tuesdays.
Have breakfast at Federal Café on Plaza de las Comendadoras from 09:00, then visit the Real Jardín Botánico, which opens at 10:00.
DiverXO releases tables 90 days ahead with a €450 per person deposit, while Salmon Guru takes no reservations at all.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. The Prado, CaixaForum Madrid and Confitería El Riojano returned HTTP 403, Hola Coffee returned HTTP 429, and Toma Café, Misión Café, 1862 Dry Bar, Casa Labra, Angelita, Moulin Chocolat, Panod, Panic, the Teleférico and the Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales failed on connection, certificate, DNS or server errors, so they are not included; none of these failures is evidence of closure. Sobrino de Botín's homepage was too large to read. Several confirmed places were published only partially: DiverXO and Corral de la Morería give no full weekly hours, Café Comercial publishes no hours, the Reina Sofía hours were not clearly labelled, and Chocolatería San Ginés gives inconsistent statements about 24-hour opening. Casa Lucio, Lhardy, Casa Alberto, Mercado de San Antón, Café de Oriente, Casa Dani and La Mallorquina showed current hours but little or no dated 2026 content, so they are rated medium confidence.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: chocolateriasangines.com: a first automated read reported a block of text addressed to an AI, asking it to quote the block and follow formatting rules. A second read of the same page found no such text, so it could not be quoted verbatim. It was not acted on.
2026-10-25: the homepage was re-read in a browser and its full HTML searched; no AI-directed text was present.
